title: One click is never a pattern — a bare wrong on one programme's card changes only that file

objects.subject: Founder showcase — would you present?
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

We are putting together a founder showcase for our community next month. Would you like to present Nimbus Labs? Let me know if you are interested.

Nadia Qureshi
Programme Lead, TechBridge Foundation

objects.subject: Your application — interview slot
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Your application has moved to the interview round. Please pick an interview slot on the calendar link by Friday.

Vikram Sole
Coordinator, Awadh Enterprise Centre
